name: petry-chart-bundle-build
description: Dev-time build: bundles the real @aai-agency/og-components chart + its compiled Tailwind CSS into the self-contained artifact the petry plugin ships. Resolves the library from the local aai-og-components workspace (0.4.1 is not yet on npm). Run `pnpm i && pnpm build`; the output (skills/get-well-production/assets/preview.html) is committed so users never build.
